node: Data-center power, thermal management, and grid-edge infrastructure
summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expansion for the data-center power/thermal/grid-edge node. The reference lane keeps Vertiv as the clean public benchmark for integrated data-center power and cooling. The underfollowed lane prioritizes Powell Industries, Modine Manufacturing, and IES Holdings because their exposures map directly to switchgear/power distribution, data-center cooling systems, and electrical/technology installation services rather than to headline AI chips or hyperscalers. These are research candidates only, not trading recommendations. Layer 1B expanded the universe around data-center electrical balance-of-plant, thermal management, and grid-edge constraints. Reference leaders remain useful context, but the more interesting discovery lane is in medium-voltage switchgear, packaged power systems, liquid-cooling components, data-center thermal systems, and enclosure/power-distribution suppliers. The main chokepoint pattern is that AI data centers raise rack density and power demand faster than electrical and thermal infrastructure can be specified, procured, commissioned, and connected. Layer 1B expands the universe beneath the obvious AI-chip and hyperscaler layer into electrical balance-of-plant, switchgear, thermal systems, backup power, and deployment services. The strongest underfollowed candidates from this pass are Powell Industries for medium-voltage switchgear and data-center power systems, Modine for AI data-center thermal management, and EnerSys for backup energy storage and batteries.
